flags.why: The busy sense, including mắc việc, is also standard Northern usage, so the regional restriction is misleading ([dictionary](https://vietnamthuquan.eu/TacPham/tu-dien-tieng-viet-1713/chuong-34)).
flags.fix: Remove the Central and Southern tags.

flags.why: Mắc nợ is used nationwide rather than being restricted to Central and Southern Vietnamese ([dictionary](https://vietnamthuquan.eu/TacPham/tu-dien-tieng-viet-1713/chuong-34)).
flags.fix: Remove the Central and Southern tags.

flags.why: Mắc cỡ describes being shy or embarrassed, not making someone else feel that way.
flags.fix: to feel; to be (in expressions such as mắc cỡ, to be shy or embarrassed, and mắc cười, to feel like laughing)

flags.why: Thùng does not mean a garment's waist; tucking in a shirt is expressed by đóng thùng ([usage](https://vlstudies.wordpress.com/2022/05/18/learn-vietnamese-online-so-vin/)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: The common general container sense, encountered in thùng rác and thùng đựng đồ, is missing from the narrower carton and barrel glosses.
flags.fix: noun | box; bin; container; ex: Bỏ rác vào thùng. = Put the rubbish in the bin.
